==English==
{{wp}}

===Etymology===
{{ety|en|:af|menstruum|-ation|:influence|la-lat:menstruatio|tree=1}}
From {{af|en|menstruum|-ation}}, modelled after {{der|en|la-lat|menstruatio}}. The word is a cognate with {{cog|fr|menstruation}}, {{cog|es|menstruación}},<ref>{{R:OED Online|part of speech=n|id=116518|date=September 2001}}</ref> which displaced {{inh|en|ang|mōnaþblōd|lit=monthblood}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ˌmɛnstɹuːˈeɪʃən/|/ˌmɛnstɹʊˈeɪʃən/|a=RP}}
* {{IPA|en|/ˌmɛnstɹuˈeɪʃən/|/-stɹəˈweɪ-/|/ˌmɛnˈstɹeɪʃən/|a=GA}} {{qualifier|the latter pronunciation leading to the spelling {{m|en|menstration}}}}
* {{audio|en|menstruation US.ogg|a=GA|q=longer pronunciation|IPA=/ˌmɛnstɹuˈeɪʃən/}}
* {{audio|en|menstration US.ogg|a=GA|q=short pronunciation|IPA=/ˌmɛnˈstɹeɪʃən/}}
* {{rhymes|en|eɪʃən|s=4}}
* {{hyphenation|en|men|stru|a|tion}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun|~}}

# The [[periodic]] [[discharging#Noun|discharging]] of the [[menses]], the flow of [[blood]] and [[cell]]s from the [[lining#Noun|lining]] of the [[uterus]] in [[unfertilized]] [[female]]s of [[human]]s and other [[primate]]s.
# An [[instance]] of [[#Noun|menstruation]], the [[part]] of [[each]] [[month]] during which a [[fertile]] [[woman]] [[menstruate]]s.

====Alternative forms====
* {{l|en|menstration}} {{q|nonstandard, possibly proscribed}}

====Synonyms====
* ''See'' [[Thesaurus:menstruation]].
